**Continuous 2.6.1**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.6.1.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                     |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.6.1.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.6.1.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.6.1.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.6.1.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.6.1.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.6.1.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.6.1-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.6.1.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.6.1-vscode/continuous-cli-2.6.1.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.6.0

A patch release.

- **Policy areas are wired through the IDE, CLI and loop.** Command analysis, a Loops panel and the README install section land with it. (#391)
- **Toolbox drawer.** Pre-canned problem-solving prompts in the chat input. (#379)
- **Qwen tail reminder** arms measured on Strata's Qwen3.8-Flash, recorded in the plans. (#376)
- **Dependencies:** `@ai-sdk/openai` 4.0.109 and `@ai-sdk/anthropic` 4.0.97 in the OpenAI adapters, `actions/setup-java` 6.2.0 in the JetBrains test action. (#390, #389, #380)

## Not included

The JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continuous. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
